feasibility: Directory existence and broad counts do not establish that 1500 distinct currently public Russian OTC chats exist. Strict OTC plus Russian classification requires verification per group; many OTC profiles have English-only descriptions despite Russian membership. No honest fixed 1500 guarantee without changing taxonomy or adding authorized Telegram API discovery. All seeded metrics are observations, not live guarantees.

github_actions_sources.finding: Minimum cron interval five minutes. Scheduled runs can be delayed or dropped under high load. Scheduled workflows only run on default branch. Public repository schedules disabled after 60 days without activity.
GitHub-hosted job maximum runtime six hours. Actions alone cannot promise uninterrupted 24/7 process or realtime updates.
